rubric_content.text_property: Every claim in the body must be traceable to the raw source material — no fabricated facts, numbers, or attributions.
The body must not simply repeat the raw note verbatim; it should add structure or clarity (headings, lists, a clearer restatement).
The title and description must accurately reflect what the body actually says.

The body must be substantial enough to be useful on its own, not a single vague sentence. This also rules out a fragment of a larger table or list that only makes sense next to sibling data — e.g. a bare list of numbers/values, an isolated table row or cell, or prose that just describes 'this is a data point' or 'this table contains values' without conveying any real, standalone insight.
